title: Data transfer in Manhattan using RocksDB
summary: Stops RocksDB write stalls from throttling node streaming by disabling them on a destination that serves no reads yet.

title: How we built Twitter’s highly reliable ads pacing service
summary: Keeps uncacheable pacing always on via shards whose replicas all compute but only the ZooKeeper leader writes.

title: Adopting RocksDB within Manhattan
summary: Migrates off MhBtree, a hard-to-change MySQL plugin with poor compression, to RocksDB via Merge and compaction hooks.

title: Sharding, simplification, and Twitter’s ads serving platform
summary: Replaces per-shard announcements, which made resharding a group deploy, with ShardLib's single path for all shards.

title: Kafka as a storage system
summary: Replays webhook events missed in outages from a Kafka topic keyed by webhook ID, since Hadoop jobs were too slow.

title: Distributed training of sparse ML models — Part 2: Optimized strategies
summary: Avoids sending FullSparse weights over capped egress by sharding them by feature rows, fed by many input pipelines.

title: Distributed training of sparse ML models — Part 1: Network bottlenecks
summary: Shows parameter-server training crawls on big sparse models, since each step ships the model through capped egress.

title: Reducing search indexing latency to one second
summary: Removes the indexing delay of sorting out-of-order Tweets by replacing prepend-only posting lists with skip lists.

title: MetricsDB: TimeSeries Database for storing metrics at Twitter
summary: Replaces Manhattan, strained by per-metric writes, with a Gorilla-compressed MetricsDB that batches writes by source.

title: Improving key expiration in Redis
summary: Traces evictions after a Redis 3.2 upgrade to expired keys piling up, then makes the expiry sample size configurable.

title: Native secondary indexing in Manhattan
summary: Replaces app-side index datasets, hard to keep correct without transactions, with index-first writes checked on read.

title: ZooKeeper at Twitter
summary: Keeps session-setup writes and client connections off the quorum with local sessions and Observers serving clients.

title: Omnisearch index formats
summary: Lifts Earlybird's caps on positions per document and index size by storing postings, positions and metadata apart.

title: Strong consistency in Manhattan
summary: Fixes check-and-set races in eventually consistent Manhattan by having replicas replay a per-shard DistributedLog log.

title: Hadoop filesystem at Twitter
summary: Hides long per-namespace HDFS URIs behind a /DC/cluster/path view whose mount tables TwitterViewFs builds at startup.

title: Building DistributedLog: High-performance replicated log service
summary: Stops Manhattan replicas diverging on compare-and-set with DistributedLog, built on BookKeeper for its I/O isolation.

title: New Tweets per second record, and how!
summary: Replaces a Rails monolith and time-sharded MySQL, which buckled in Tweet spikes, with JVM services and hash sharding.
